Card Q&A.a: This card can DNA digivolve using a level 6 green or yellow Digimon and a level 6 black or blue Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: What DNA digivolution combinations are possible with this card's DNA digivolution requirements?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 play cost 7 or lower Digimon card with the [NSp] trait from your hand without paying the cost. If DNA digivolving, you may instead play up to 2 such Digimon cards with different colors from your hand without paying the cost.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn for each of your Digimon.
Special Digivolution Condition: [DNA Digivolve] Green/yellow Lv.6 + black/blue Lv.6: Cost 0
